labs.title: Foundations, files, Chat, and first saved note

checks.fresh-install: Fresh-cache locked core installation succeeds without installing CLI, Chromium, or research dependencies as a startup requirement
checks.access: GitHub and editor Chat work with the intended attendee account
checks.orientation: Concepts-only first block and labelled visual guide checked in browser-based Codespaces before terminal use
checks.chat-turn: A real editor Chat request and refinement completed without terminal setup
checks.first-note: Separate 10:00 block: learner created and corrected a brief, saved, reviewed, committed, pushed, and read back the same branch on GitHub

checks.first-page: Learner followed the shared fictional weekend-planner brief, then personalised it; no finished template, research, or tool-configuration prerequisite
checks.preview: One preview command introduced after Chat; actual private Ports preview opens the learner's page
checks.manual-behaviour: Coached 11:45 block: expected-versus-observed manual button check, with real fixes rechecked
checks.source-check: Coached 11:45 block: displayed figure, units, and calculation compared with the supplied source, not the model's confidence

optional_checks.research-mcp: Selected optional browser and document tools actually invoked; installation alone is insufficient
optional_checks.browser-download: Playwright inspected the official archive and at least one actual PDF download and reporting year; remaining years and blockers recorded truthfully
optional_checks.conversion: A real MarkItDown conversion inspected; complete file output retained and any CLI fallback or truncation distinguished from MCP success
optional_checks.facts: Comparable facts checked against original public sources with years, units, locations, calculations, and live/prepared labels
optional_checks.visual-brief: Optional visual-brief invoked with verified facts without overwriting the learner's site; charts, references, navigation, and layout checked

checks.implementation: One meaningful interaction implemented in the existing page with fictional input and safe text handling
checks.personalisation: One learner-chosen improvement inspected against the actual diff and page
checks.manual-checks: Manual add/remove or equivalent journey, empty input, keyboard access, and narrow layout checked honestly
checks.preview: Learner reopened the private preview and recorded actual results and remaining limitations

optional_checks.storage: If selected, add/reload/present/remove/reload observed in one browser; corrupt or unavailable storage handled without clearing other apps' data

checks.reviewed-files: Selected changes and site assets exclude private material, credentials, full reports, and unrelated changes
checks.reviewed-commit: Reviewed work pushed and read back on the intended GitHub branch through the beginner workflow
checks.checked-feature: Private preview still works after the last improvement; learner explains an actual check and limitation
checks.no-azure-login: No attendee Azure login or credential creation used; publication is not required for Monday

optional_checks.actions: Deploy workflow succeeded for that commit using the prepared runner identity
optional_checks.endpoint: Website-target artifact and fresh responses match the exact commit, label, entry-page bytes, and site fingerprint; no vendor-app substitution
optional_checks.deployed-behaviour: Chosen interaction verified at the actual new deployment URL, not just the health endpoint
optional_checks.deployed-storage: Only if storage was selected, its journey repeated at the deployment origin without assuming preview state transfers

checks.idea-brief: Participant chose an own idea or the default, described one user outcome and check, and used a prepared repository without overwriting Monday's work
checks.prototype: A bounded prototype or improved default works with fictional app-local content; no service integration or account migration was required
checks.manual-journey: Expected versus observed user journey, input handling, and one useful improvement checked manually
checks.saved-work: Reviewed changes committed, pushed, and read back from the intended GitHub branch
checks.handover: Working features and unresolved data/access/approval questions recorded for the technical owner; no training membership or personal account deleted

checks.cli-turn: Separate 09:00-09:15 introduction: actual Codespaces Copilot CLI request and refinement, with independent authentication/context checked
checks.issue-session: Focused synthetic issue assigned to the actual cloud agent with an inspected session
checks.iteration: Precise PR correction requested and resulting changes inspected
checks.pr-tests: Tests and checks passed on the actual PR commit, not an unrelated branch
checks.human-review: Required human review completed without bypassing branch protections

labs.title: Prepared browser introduction and remote GitHub MCP

checks.browser-tools: Separate 10:45-11:15 introduction: prepared Playwright connection inspected, trusted, and actually invoked in editor Chat
checks.browser-journey: Existing personal page or local-sample vendor reader checked by Playwright and compared with a manual observation; no live database required
checks.configuration: Authenticated remote GitHub MCP exposes only the intended read-only tools
checks.invocation: Actual MCP call returned the rehearsal issue and matched its GitHub source
checks.cleanup: Connection disabled if required by the agreed rehearsal policy

labs.title: Automations, hooks, and adjacent readiness block

checks.automation: Matching issue event started the configured Copilot automation, not a manual substitute
checks.report-pr: Automation produced an inspected generated-report PR with unchanged evaluator results
checks.live-hook: Hook wiring loaded in a real CLI session and recorded metadata-only tool events
checks.deny: Harmless exact-tool denial observed and compared with its direct helper test
checks.cleanup: Test automation disabled and temporary deny flag removed
checks.repeatable-browser: Separate 11:15 readiness block: saved assertion-based browser script ran twice; MCP observations and actual CI browser coverage distinguished
checks.release-checks: Reviewed final commit has actual test/lint results and inspected CI evidence
checks.selected-release: One approved website or local-sample vendor target deployed with Dataverse disabled; artifact and fresh responses match exact commit, label and intended source, plus website fingerprints when selected; public writes remain disabled
checks.release-journey: Meaningful feature checked at the actual deployment URL; optional storage and remaining rollout gaps recorded separately

labs.title: Deeper agent authoring and evidence handoffs

checks.skill-review: Separate 09:00 opening: one everyday-work skill's complete files, licence, dependencies and permissions reviewed; invocation or explicit bookmark/blocker distinguished
checks.discovery: Authored agent and skill discovered and actually invoked
checks.missing-evidence: Missing input and silent-source cases do not invent facts or evaluator JSON
checks.semantics: Negative encryption, undefined retention, residency contradiction, and unstated SOC 2 counterexamples pass
checks.handoffs: Actual repository-local analyst, writer, and reviewer invocations used original source and unchanged evaluator JSON; retired organization duplicate not used
checks.baseline: Agent-authored report compared against untouched separate CLI baseline and source quotes
checks.commit: Authored customization files reviewed and committed
